requirements.title: POPPAR returns one for odd POPCNT and zero for even POPCNT
requirements.definition: POPPAR(I) has value one for an odd POPCNT(I) value and zero for an even POPCNT(I) value.

pending.POPPAR-odd-count-result-one: Construct integers with one and three set bits using IBSET from zero; initialize sentinels to -1 and assert POPPAR returns 1 for both, with POPCNT companions proving odd counts.
pending.POPPAR-even-count-result-zero: Construct zero and a two-set-bit integer; assert POPPAR returns 0 only with odd-count companion cases present, and mutate the second bit-setting operation.
